title: Agent commands get site secrets blanked, a read-only seat runs no shell in the container, and a WordPress look change goes into Additional CSS instead of the theme's files
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/tools/tracy-subprocess-docker/test/route.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-subprocess-docker/test/provider.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/look-set.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/look-undo.test.mjs

S2: Read the result of each test named below. The dsh fork part (file tools open the file that was resolved) is judged in the fork by packages/fs/fs-local/tests/opened-target.spec.ts (vitest; its race cases run where /proc exists).
expect: 'execArgv: site secrets an agent command does not need are blanked, after the caller asks them back' passes.
'spawn: a read-only seat runs no command in the container, and says what to use instead; its grep still runs' passes.

'WordPress: the Additional CSS a person already wrote is kept, the rule goes after it, and look.revert puts back exactly what was there' and 'WordPress: look.revert refuses when the Additional CSS changed after the look change' pass.
'WordPress: where Additional CSS is printed decides how specific the rule is' passes.
fence: Each test drives the mechanism: a caller env asking a blanked secret back, a read-only stamped spawn, a WordPress look.set against a fake wp-cli holding existing Additional CSS, a revert after a person's save, block vs classic theme print order. No model, no network.

tests: execArgv: site secrets an agent command does not need are blanked
spawn: a read-only seat runs no command in the container
WordPress: the Additional CSS a person already wrote is kept
WordPress: look.revert refuses when the Additional CSS changed after the look change
WordPress: where Additional CSS is printed decides how specific the rule is
